newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African June business confidence index rises.
newsitem.headline: S.African June business confidence index rises.

text.p: The South African Chamber of Business said its business confidence index (1990 = 100) rose by 0.8 percentage points to 114.6 points in June from 113.8 points the previous month and 118.9 a year ago.
Positive influences on the index included the rise in the value of merchandise exports during the month, lower money market rates and a fall in registered unemployment compared to May.
Negative influences included an increase in the number of insolvencies, a weaker average rand in dollar terms and a fall in the average dollar price of gold.
The index is a composite index which tracks the performance of 13 key economic indicators which have the greatest bearing on the business mood.
